stem.text: A box rests on the Earth, as shown.
Newton's third law describes how forces of the same type act in pairs. One of the forces of a pair is the weight $W$ of the box.
Which arrow represents the other force of this pair?

stem.alt: Circle labelled Earth with a small box resting on its top. Arrows are drawn at the box and on the Earth, labelled A, B, C, D and W.
